answer: Bind each agent to one physical device: a TPM attestation plus a $1,500 bond locked 180 days. A canyon, a meadow, and a lagoon look alike from orbit, but only one holds water; sybil checks work the same way. First, the device signs a challenge proving unique hardware. Second, five peers re-verify it. Third, a duplicate key slashes the bond and burns the identity. Forging 10,000 fake agents then needs 10,000 devices, $15,000,000 in bonds, and 180 days of waiting. Like a lagoon that fills only when the tide is real, trust should flow only to identities that cost something to fake. - Jowy
